en: The Holy Land... Asyl.
I can't believe it. To think that\nI'm standing right in the center\nof the Holy Land War.
The center? Don't get it\ntwisted. This is the shadows.
The shadows of history, where\nthings never come to light.

...I get where both of you are
coming from. But it doesn't
matter how it looks from the
outside.
For us, this place is definitely\nthe center of our lives.
Whether we wanted it to be or\nnot... right?
...According to Administrator\nKoro's data,

the navies of Rubarika and
Baschen have engaged in
battle at a point approximately
two kilometers to the west.
The situation appears to\nslightly favor Rubarika.
We must solve the mystery of\nAsyl quickly to minimize the\ncasualties on both sides.
Tika must be worried as well.
You're right. Let's go,\neveryone...
Verda?
...Hmm.
What's wrong?
...Mmm. I understand what\nRicardo is saying... Tika's\nsafety comes first...
But, I still wish she could have\ncome with us.

What? You got a problem too?
It seems your long time
stranded has made you forget
your duty as a soldier.
This is a war. Not some kid's\ngame of playing hero.

As a soldier, it's absolutely
unacceptable to bring a civilian
child to the front lines of a
war.

No, my apologies, Captain. I
shouldn't have brought up
something that's already been
decided...
Well, I can understand how\nVerda feels.
Besides, by Ricardo's logic,\nEve, Verda, and Welch should\nalso be left waiting on the ship.
Leave Tika behind on the\nship?! What do you mean by\nthat!
Sister Verda...
Whoa, is it really that\nsurprising?
We're heading to the Holy Land\nthat Rubarika and Baschen are\nfighting tooth and nail to seize.
There's no way in hell we can\ntake Tika to a place like that.
...I'm sorry, but I agree on that\npoint.

Historically, the battles that
follow the emergence of a Holy
Land result in even more
casualties than before.

Especially this time, Rubarika
has those new Light Arrows,
and Baschen has that strange
phenomenon that transformed
the witches.
The danger is on a completely\ndifferent level than what we've\nfaced.
Indeed. Furthermore, our\ndestination is an unknown area\nfor which no prior data exists.

A Holy Land that cannot be
detected by your technology
likely contains countless
unknown traps.
I must also oppose Tika coming\nalong.
Karlyn... and now Henri too.
There is no room to argue with\nthe three of them.
I want to respect Verda's\nfeelings in accepting Tika as a\ncomrade,

but as a matter of duty, I
cannot allow Tika to be sent to
the front lines of battle any
longer.
Tika.
Yes?
I'm sorry. Could you wait for us\nto return here?
Euwin!?
Verda, remember what\nhappened at Baschen's Imperial\nCastle.
Baschen's Imperial Castle?
Tika's Arms were destroyed in\nthat battle.

Later, when she was attacked
by the local beasts in Daftes,
what do you think would have
happened to Tika if Valka
hadn't saved her?
It's true that Tika has fought\nalongside us this whole time.
But that's only because of the\npower of these Arms you\ncreated, Verda.

If those Arms were to break
deep within the Holy Land, Tika
would be left defenseless on
the battlefield.
That's... if it comes to that,\nCoro can just retrieve her!
My apologies. That is\nimpossible.
I figured as much.
Yes. I cannot scan the interior\nof the Holy Land Asyl at all.

Ideally, I would like to transport
everyone directly to the
deepest part, but since I
cannot do that, we must
assume retrieval is also
impossible.
...Verda. I understand how you\nfeel, but in this situation...
...Thank you, Big Sister Verda.
I'll stay behind.
Tika...
I can't fight on my own. I don't\nwant everyone to worry about\nme, and besides...
As long as I'm with Coro, I'll be\nsafe.
I see... you're right.
I'll stay here and wait for\neveryone to come back.
So... please come back safe\nand sound. The battle isn't\nover until we're all home.
Exactly. No matter what\nhappens ahead, we've all gotta\ncome back here eventually.
Even if we blow the Holy Land\nto smithereens, there's still\nmore to do after that.
This isn't some final showdown,\nso things like this happen from\ntime to time.
I understand...
Tika, we're off. Be a good girl\nand wait for us.
I will! You be careful too, Sister\nVerda!

Leave it to me. I shall wait for
the Captain and the others
along with Miss Tika and
Rekoro.
It's settled then.
We're out of time. Let's head\ndown.
...So, everything's been played\nout exactly as they wanted.
What's wrong?
...I'm just feeling depressed\nthinking about what comes\nnext.
Really? Well, as long as that's\nall.
This place will be a battlefield\nsoon. And we have no idea\nwhat's happening inside Asyl.
Don't let your guard down, any\nof you. Let's move.

...You've suddenly started
acting like the leader, but
aren't you a general? Shouldn't
you be leading the Rubarika
army?
Someone else is handling that.\nMy job right now is to crush\nAsyl.
Someone else...? The King of\nRubarika?

Huh? There's no way an
incompetent fool like him could
hold his own in a real fight
against Baschen.

He's the kind of guy who'd
waste his forces one by one on
a national scale, just because
he's relying on the Light
Arrows.
Then who on earth is it?
I'll tell you once we've put an\nend to this Holy War.

Let's move. I've heard the path
ahead is a demon's den that'll
make Baschen's beasts look
cute.
Y-yes. Understood.
Welch, don't go messing with\nanything strange, okay?
I can't make any promises.
Hey!
Dr. Belda. What is the matter?\nYou've been silent for some\ntime now.
Dr. Belda: ...I am troubled by\nwhat Ricardo said.
What do you mean?
You didn't notice, Valka?
Hm?
Dr. Belda: Ricardo has had\ncontact with an advanced\nplanetary civilization.

Dr. Belda: It is clear from his
knowledge of the armor's
materials and the Captain's
ship. There is no doubt he is
from an advanced planet.

Dr. Belda: If that is the case,
one would expect him to
possess a more large-scale
means of destroying the Holy
Land.
...I see.

Dr. Belda: As for his obsession
with Tika, it is possible that
they are actually
acquaintances.

Dr. Belda: But if that were true,
I cannot understand why he
refuses to show his face, nor
why he is so aggressive in
trying to end the Holy Land
War.
Dr. Belda: I believe he is telling\nthe truth about prioritizing\nTika's safety, but...
Even so, his way of protecting\nTika is far too roundabout.
If he knows that ending the\nHoly War leads to a better\nfuture for Tika,
then ending the war and\nensuring Tika's safety aren't\ncontradictory...
But the question is, how did\nRicardo find that out in the\nfirst place?
Logically speaking, it would\nmean he is also acting under\nsomeone else's will.
Exactly. And that person is\nlikely...
That emissary of Daftes...\nElaine, if I recall correctly.
It wouldn't be unusual if\nRicardo was recruited during\nthe previous Holy War.
And Ricardo has a reason why\nhe cannot defy that person.

Especially since he possesses
enough power to fight the
Beast Witch and Baschen's
beasts.
I see.

He's also been hinting
throughout our conversations
that he's receiving information
about Asyl from someone.
He is not to be\nunderestimated. We would do\nwell to stay on our guard.
Very well.
Understood.
...To be honest, I am grateful to\nyou two.
Henri & Valka: Hm?
Hmm?
Eve and the Captain are\nwonderful in their own way,\nbut...

They are far too
straightforward to be
entrusted with this kind of
political maneuvering.
...Actually, I'm not very good at\nthat sort of thing...
I doubt that.

Valka, your shifts in demeanor
may be flashy, but your actions
always align with your words.
You are a first-class warrior,
after all.
Really? You think so... ehehe...\nfirst-class, he said I'm\nfirst-class... ehehe...

...You are, how should I put
this, prone to Nervous Tension.
Couldn't you act more like a
child and leave things to
others for once?
It's a habit I inherited from my\ngrandfather. That's one thing I\nsimply cannot change.
Who on earth are these people\nnesting in this holy land?

I mean, why are there even
people like this in a holy land
that was supposed to be at
the bottom of the ocean!?

They look much newer than the
ones Henri encountered. This is
making things incredibly
difficult.

Aww, it's such a waste to
break them! I want to study
them! Hey, can't I take a few of
the broken pieces back with
me!?

I don't mind, but you'll have to
hold off Rubarika and Baschen
by yourself when they push up
from below.
Che, stingy! Coro! You can\ncommunicate, right! Can't you\njust retrieve these things!?

I cannot! Even this voice
communication is barely holding
on, using ancient radio waves
that are on the verge of
cutting out!

If I tried to teleport and
contain them in this state, their
molecular structure would be
destroyed!
What a waste! This is so unfair!
...Wait, huh? What's that?
What is it? Something is\nmoving in the corridor.

It doesn't seem to be
attacking... it looks like some
kind of polyhedral object,
almost spherical.
Of all the objects moving within\nthis place, this one is\nparticularly strange.

<font color=blue>Valka</font>: I've done a quick scan. It
appears to be a hybrid device
incorporating both Symbology
and mechanical structures.

The patterns engraved on the
surface seem to be an
application of teleportation
symbology.
<font color=blue>Karlyn</font>: Teleportation\nsymbology?

<font color=blue>Valka</font>: Exactly what it sounds
like―a spell that transports
whatever it touches to a
designated location.
I believe it corresponds to the\nsymbol engraved on the floor\nat the entrance of this floor.
<font color=blue>Euwin</font>: So you're saying if we\ntouch that thing, we'll be sent\nright back to the entrance...

<font color=blue>Eve</font>: Hey, Coro. Can you
analyze the movement of that
weird object just from the
video feed?

The corridor is narrow, and it
would be terrible if we
accidentally touched it and got
separated. I wonder if you can
at least analyze its movement
patterns...
Wait, Captain?
<font color=blue>Coro</font>: "Yes, you're right. This is\nprobably...
Found it! I'll run the\ncalculations now!"
<font color=blue>Eve</font> W-what's wrong?

<font color=blue>Coro</font> 『Calculations complete.
I'm transferring the
polyhedron's movement
patterns to the Captain's Quad
Scanner.

It's a lot of data since it's a
radio transmission... but I think
this movement pattern should
work.』
<font color=blue>Eve</font> What do you mean...

Wait, this is incredibly detailed.
You can tell all this just by
looking? Did you actually
calculate this!?
<font color=blue>Coro</font> 『I did! There's no mistake!
Actually, something has been\nbothering me for a while now...

The structural philosophy of
this holy land, Asyl, is strikingly
similar to several structures in
the Galactic Federation's
database.』
<font color=blue>Ricardo</font> ....
<font color=blue>Verda</font> What is the meaning of\nthis?

<font color=blue>Coro</font> 『The polyhedron in
question is also a dead ringer
for the devices installed in
those structures.』
<font color=blue>Eve</font> Really? What kind of\nstructures are they?
<font color=blue>Coro</font> "I don't think you'd\nrecognize the name even if I\ntold you, Eve."
<font color=blue>Eve</font> Hey!! You can't just leave\nit at that...!
<font color=blue>Ricardo</font> Your analysis is\nprobably correct.
<font color=blue>Coro</font> "Huh?"

<font color=blue>Ricardo</font> I've heard that
buildings similar to this holy
land, Asyl, exist all over the
universe.
Every single one of them is in\nthe middle of nowhere, hidden\nin strange ways,

and they all have defense
mechanisms inside to remove
intruders without harming
them.
The most famous example... is\napparently called the <font color=yellow>Purge\nTemple</font>.
<font color=blue>Coro</font> "Ricardo?!"
<font color=blue>Valka</font> The Purge Temple?!\nGeneral Ricardo! Why do you\nknow of such a place...

<font color=blue>Ricardo</font> If you want to know
why, keep running toward the
back. I'm not saying another
word.
<font color=blue>Ricardo</font> Don't look at me like\nthat. It's not like I have\nfirsthand knowledge.

But one thing I can tell you is
that the architecture of the
holy land of Asyl isn't
particularly rare in this
universe.
What is... this sphere? It's\ncreepy...
Creepy? What is? It's just a\nblack ball.

I agree... It's like a foul stench
of Symbology. This is certainly
not something that should be
in a place like the Holy Land.
Though I suppose someone as\ndull as you wouldn't\nunderstand.
You always have to get the\nlast word in, don't you!

Strange. While it could be
called a high-energy body,
based on material analysis
alone, it's nothing more than a
lump of ordinary marble.

It has no value as a precious
metal, nor is it something that
could act as a catalyst for
Symbology.
What on earth is this...?

I don't care. As long as I smash
this thing, the Holy Land of
Asyl will collapse and the Holy
Land War will end.
And while I'm at it, I'll wipe out\nevery last bit of the wretched\ncalamity haunting Daftine.
What do you mean? What else\nis eating away at this planet\nbesides the Holy Land War...?
No time for chatter. Get out of\nmy way.
I'm gonna smash―
Wait! Don't go any closer!!
Huh!?
Something... something is\ncoming!!
What do you mean,\n"something"...?
My genes... they're being pulled.\nThe genes of my Beast\nDisease...
What is this? Is it the stench\nof the Crest that Karlyn\nmentioned?
No, this is different.
Look! A black stone!!
Approaching the rift is\nforbidden.
What was that voice!?
Look, over there!!
What the hell is this thing?! I\nnever heard anything about\nthis being here!!
To think such a creature was\nin the holy land... Rubarika,\nBaschen... all for this thing!
It's coming!!
*Huff, puff!* T-that was a\nshock, but... but we managed\nto pull through... *Whew!*
So, was that the final guardian\nof the Holy Land of Asyl?
A guardian, huh?

I hadn't heard anything about
that, but it wouldn't be
surprising for a place like this
to have one.
Karlyn? What's wrong?
Didn't it seem... familiar?
Huh?
Like those strange forms the\nwitches were transformed into\nback in Korurine...
...Well, it did have some weird\nfeathers...
That too, but more than that...\nthe stench of the crest felt\nsimilar...
You're right... It felt like that\nfight lacked any real\nsubstance...

Whatever, we beat it in the
end, so who cares! Let's just
smash this black thing and be
done with it...
Huh?
What!!
Welch!! Look out!!
Gwah!!
E-Eu!!
What is this! What happened!
This is bad! How is this\npossible! He's completely\nunscathed!!
W-Why?! How?! I didn't detect\nany reaction at all!!
You shall not be permitted to\napproach the Gap.
Eu! Eu, stay with me!!
Dammit... something's wrong...\nthe power is even greater than\nbefore... what is this thing!
He's coming again!!
Unforgivable!
W-what the hell is going on...?!\nNo matter how many we take\ndown, they just keep coming...!
It hurts... it hurts so much...
W-what incredible power...
*Pant*... *pant*! E-everyone, we\nhave to... fight back...!
B-but at this rate... we're just\nwearing ourselves down...!
Karlyn... pull yourself together...
I don't feel like we can beat\nthem at all! No matter how\nmany I slash...!

I-it's impossible! With the radio
signals cutting in and out like
this, teleporting is far more
dangerous than just recovering
enemy wreckage!
Just... a little more... if we can\njust break it... before that\nbastard shows up again...
That would be problematic.
Gah!!

Though, I suspect neither the
black sphere nor its guardian
are cheap enough to be
destroyed by the likes of you.
...Givel...

Hehehe... Quite impressive. I
didn't expect you to be this
stubborn. A delightful...
delightful miscalculation.
Watching the movements of\nyour ship in orbit, I knew\nEvelysse hadn't gone far,
but I didn't expect you to\nactually come flying back to\nme.
...Damn it, why...
It seems this war is a victory\nfor Baschen. General Ricardo.

The Crown Prince's army,
leading the Exorciser test
subjects I bestowed upon my
"Beast" and the "Witch of the
Beast," will likely suppress
Rubarika within a few days.
Y-you've got to be kidding...\nNot after we've come this far...!

Givel... you piece of... What
"Beast"? What "servant"? Don't
act so high and mighty, you
crest-stealing thief...
A crest-stealing thief, am I?
Heh heh heh... So it was\nMastima behind you after all.

You lack the courage to even
leave the tower, yet you remain
so diligently devoted to
dragging others down. It's truly
tiresome.
...Mastima... isn't that the name\nof this planet's moon...?

Ah, Evelysse. There is no need
to worry. I am merely speaking
of a pest who happens to have
a slightly larger ego than most.
This time, I shall ensure you\nremain by my side.
Last time, I tried to take a\nshortcut, and things nearly\nspiraled out of control.
This time, I will be certain to\n"erase" these "comrades" of\nyours.
...Don't you... dare!
Don't think things will go your\nway so easily!
Very well! Struggle all you like.

Guardians. Do not interfere. I
have not yet stepped far
enough to warrant your
involvement.
So a monster... is just another\nmonster's lackey, huh!

I shall command you in the
tongue of this world, so that
even you wretched creatures
can understand! "Die"!!
Dark Star!!
Why...?! I know I landed a fatal\nblow!
Don't flinch! Keep slashing!
B-but, whether it's guns or\nSymbology, it's all being healed\ninstantly upon impact!
Waaaaah! My analysis can't\nkeep up!! I have no idea what's\nhappening!!
Tsk... stubbornly persistent...
But I'm getting bored. It's time\nfor you to disappear.
W-what's happening?!
K-k-k-k-kanchoooooooo!!
The stars! They're aligning!\nThe satellites!!
Sister Verda!! Everyone!!
Too bad for you! It's time for\nthe Moonshadow Ladder to\ndescend.
Now, Evelysse, answer me! With\nmy power!
And together, we shall bring a\ntrue Exorciser down upon this\nplanet!
A black sphere!
An abnormal amount of Gem\nenergy... is flowing into Givel!
It's coming... it's coming!!
It's here!!
That disc...! Not again!
I... I won't let you!!
Ah.
I have waited so long for this.
What... what is this!!
I... I won't let you!!
I have waited so long for this.
What... what is this?!

The Exorciser! I had no need to
rely on substitutes like the
Beast Witch or the Guardian of
the Holy Land!
At last, I have found the true\nExorciser! A new world begins\nnow!
There is an abnormal crest\nreaction oscillating between\nEve's disc and Givel's disc!
I suspect their spells are\nresonating!
Eve! You have to stop the\nsummoning...!

Something's wrong, I can't stop
it!! The energy from the black
sphere is... it's taking over my
crest!
It's useless! Once the Exorciser\nis set in motion, it cannot be\nstopped!
From here, I shall...!
Not on my watch!!
Sparkling Stars!!
What...?!
It... it stopped...?!
W-what is this?! It's...\ncollapsing...!
Y-you! Karlyn Kayson!!
The crest reaction is\ncontracting abnormally...
Lord Givel... I was once grateful\nto you. I served you with all my\nheart and soul.
But... you did things that no\nhuman should ever do.
You forced us to do them...

And then, you betrayed us. You
betrayed the people wounded
by war... and you betrayed my
heart!
Y-you insolent...!!
...I will never forgive you.
What!? D-damn you, Karlyn\nKayson! To think you\npossessed this much power...!
You've had your fun for long\nenough...
My comrades...
You turned the Beast Witches\ninto those monsters!!
I don't know what wretched\nscheme you're plotting, but I\nwon't let you!
Now feel the full extent of the\ntalent you saw in the Beast\nWitches!
N-no, the rift is collapsing!
Karlyn! I'm pushing it back!! We\ncan't let that monster enter\nthis world!
I know!!
Stop! The ladder is... Curse\nyou!!
C-Captain... what's... wrong?
...It's gone.
What?
Administrator Koro... has\nvanished.
W-what do you mean by that!?

Exactly what I said... the ship is
gone. It's nowhere to be found.
The ship has vanished from
satellite orbit! What on earth is
happening...!
Vanished? You say it\nvanished...
Impossible... Tika was on that\nship... so was Coro... and\nRekoro...
He... hehehehe...
Hahaha!! How foolish! It seems\nyou've all ended up in the same\nposition as I!
What... do you mean by that...!
Evelysse, Karlyn Kayson.

Your power distorted the
direction of the energy from
the holy land of Asyl and my
own attempt to summon the
Exorciser!
What do you mean... Just\nwhat... what have you done?!
What have I done?

You are the ones who did this.
You already know that the
emissaries of Daftes arrive via
the Moonshadow Ladder.
Why do you think such beings\nappear?
It is quite simple: the\nMoonshadow Ladder creates a\nrift in space-time.

Someone from this universe is
simply caught in it and flung
here from the past or the
future.
Once they are cast away,\nthere is no way to return.
They know neither where they\ncame from nor where they are.
Those are the emissaries of\nDaftes―lost children of the\ncosmos.
Among them, some happened\nto possess technology not\nfound here on Daftine,

and those who happened to
have the power to convey that
knowledge to others were
simply prized as emissaries.
It was all mere coincidence.

The foolish primitives of
Rubarika and Baschen simply
projected their own meaning
onto it!
You... you... how dare you...!

Holy Wars where no
"Messenger" descended.
"Messengers of Daftes" who
were utterly useless.
I'm sure such stories are\nplentiful on both Rubarika and\nBaschen.

And yet, because people like
me―or the Messenger of
Rubarika from four years
ago―occasionally appear, you
people cannot stop fighting!

You are the ones who wasted
lives and fortunes, gaping open
in longing for "talent" that may
never even appear!
You... you piece of...!!
Will you kill me?
Even if you kill me, your ship\nwill not return!
Do you think killing me will\nreveal the exit to the rift\nopened in space?
If killing you would actually do\nthat, I'd do it right this\nsecond...

...Givel. Does that mean you,
too, were brought to Daftine
against your will from
somewhere else?
That understanding is not\nincorrect.

Then why commit such an
atrocity as forcibly summoning
my kin, the Daftes, to this
land?
Why, when you know that\nsuffering yourself?

Why, you ask? A half-measure
who cannot even control the
beastification plague dares to
condemn my actions?
Spare me your cheap\nprovocations.
Does one who has fallen to a\nbeast and lost their will speak\nof longing for home?
When did I ever say I was\nplagued by nostalgia?
My goal is to bring the\nExorciser down upon this land!!
The Moonshadow Ladder\ncreates rifts in space-time.

It simply means that someone
from this universe, caught in
those rifts, is cast here from
the past or future.

In the midst of that, someone
happened to possess
technology not found here in
Daftine,

and happened to have the
power to convey it to others,
making them a highly valued
messenger.
It was all merely a coincidence.
My goal is to bring the\nExorciser down upon this land!!
The Exorciser? You mean\nthose weird monsters that look\nlike a bunch of glowing stakes?
What on earth are those things\nanyway!
Evelysse. Are you being\nserious?
There is no way you could be\nignorant of the Exorciser!
Don't be ridiculous. Why would I\nknow anything about something\nso disgusting...
...I cannot tell if you are playing\ndumb or if you truly do not\nknow...!
Look out! Eve, get back!
Eve!
L-let go of me...! You...!!
Eve!
Wait! Don't get closer! You'll be\nkilled! Can't you see that black\ndisc!
Urgh...!
Good. Stay calm. As expected\nof Rubarika's great strategist,\nGeneral Ricardo...
Hehehe... To think that I, of all\npeople, must stoop to the level\nof these insects...
I didn't want it to come to this.

But there is far too much time
before the next ladder
descends. I cannot imagine you
lot staying quiet on this planet
until then...
This is the only way.
What do you plan to do with\nEve!
Nothing. I shall treat her with\nthe utmost care.
Until the next ladder descends.
Considering the years that\nhave already passed, waiting\nfor the next ladder is nothing.
Y-you think I'm just going to sit\nstill?!
You will, whether you like it or\nnot. Now be quiet. You're\ndistracting me.
Aaaah!
What are you doing to a girl,\nyou scumbag?!
You just... keep playing around!
I've grown tired of hearing\nthese pests buzz.
Soon, Asyl will vanish. And you\nshall sink into the sea along\nwith Asyl.
Never again shall you cling to\nmy heels.
Soon, Asyl will vanish. And you\nshall sink into the sea along\nwith it.
Never again shall you cling to\nmy heels.
Hey! Where the hell did he go?!\nWhat do you think you're doing,\nyou bastard!!
Eve... Tika... How on earth did\nthings end up like this...?
Confirming convergence of the\nspatial rift...
...Verda. It seems that even in\nthis situation, we have no time\nto dwell on despair.
...Wait, something is wrong.
